_comment: EDIT ME EACH YEAR. Everything here shows up on the site. No code changes needed.

dates._comment: ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. 'together' drives the live day-counter.

milestones._comment: Extra counters shown under the main day-counter.

rotatingLines: Aku nggak pernah nembak kamu. Aku cuma memutuskan kamu milikku.
Dua tahun. Masih kamu. Selalu kamu.
Bucuk, kalau dunia berat, kita berat bareng.
Kamu bukan sekadar pacarku. Kamu tujuanku.
Bebelac Gold — nutrisi terbaik buat hidupku.
We didn't have money, energy, or an easy year. We had each other. Cukup.

theme._comment: Tweak the whole colour mood from here.

music._comment: Drop an mp3 at public/audio/theme.mp3 and it will be used. Otherwise a soft generated lullaby plays.
